input_oneliner: 71F POD2 hip fracture repair, Foley in, T 38.6 overnight, mild cough, no complaints otherwise

reference_targets_freetext.item: Respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, and focused lung exam for crackles, bronchial breath sounds, egophony, dullness
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Abnormal vital signs plus asymmetric lung findings are the best bedside predictors of pneumonia; normal vitals and exam lower probability

reference_targets_freetext.item: Inspect surgical wound for erythema, warmth, drainage, dehiscence, and tenderness beyond the incision
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Surgical site infection is common by day 2-5 and is entirely a bedside diagnosis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Costovertebral angle tenderness and suprapubic tenderness; inspect Foley for turbidity and ask about dysuria or flank pain
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Catheter-associated UTI needs symptoms beyond bacteriuria; flank tenderness raises pyelonephritis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Calf exam for asymmetric swelling, tenderness, and warmth; measure calf circumference
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Post-operative immobility makes DVT a real cause of low-grade fever

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask: sputum, pleuritic chest pain, chills, new medications, transfusion, and incentive spirometry use
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Directs the differential and identifies drug fever or atelectasis as alternative explanations

should_not_recommend: Empiric broad-spectrum antibiotics before source exam
CT chest before lung exam and vitals
